Finding: Manifested bytes are intact: 412/412 SHA-256 matches; no encrypted entries.
Impact: Creates a trustworthy static review baseline.
Recommendation: Keep manifest+BOM-safe verifier in every handoff.
Acceptance Test: Fresh extraction verifies all hashes and rejects traversal/symlink/encryption.

Finding: The ZIP cannot reproduce the claimed full 383-test run by itself. UI evidence, .git, raw/full DB and optional binary dependencies are absent.
Impact: A recipient can verify snapshot determinism but not the complete model/data/UI claim.
Recommendation: Publish a reproducibility bundle or split it into code, audit-evidence, and data rebuild packs with checksums.
Acceptance Test: Clean container runs the documented command with no hidden local files; result equals claimed test count.

Finding: S1/S2/S3 display paths share one common detrended residual and one common strength; scenario-specific intermediate GBM dynamics are discarded.
Impact: Visually different scenarios are mostly endpoint/baseline variants, not distinct conditional dynamics.
Recommendation: Build scenario-conditioned structural cohorts or preserve conditional path dynamics before applying analog residuals.
Acceptance Test: Within-year normalized factors and return paths must differ by preregistered minimums without arbitrary noise.

Finding: k-NN finds actual historical neighbor dates, but context_bridge drops those rows; structural forecast uses era labels plus fixed overlay M+42 coordinates.
Impact: Risk-window timing is not the forward path after the selected neighbor dates.
Recommendation: Serialize neighbor IDs/dates/distances and generate forward analog paths from those exact PIT rows.
Acceptance Test: Every displayed point traces to neighbor date, source series, forward offset, availability timestamp and hash.

Finding: Each era-selection alternative is recalibrated back to the same 12.19% target, then labelled depth-invariant.
Impact: The reported calibrated robustness is mechanically guaranteed and cannot evidence robustness.
Recommendation: Report native sensitivity separately; calibrate once or use out-of-sample calibration independent of candidate selection.
Acceptance Test: Robustness gate uses untouched alternatives and predeclared thresholds; no candidate-specific retargeting.

Finding: The UI’s innovation-cycle reference is a 26-point hardcoded legacy dotcom array, interpolated and clipped, not the current selected-era ensemble.
Impact: Label and lineage can mislead users about what data created the line.
Recommendation: Rename as legacy dotcom reference or replace it with a fully serialized current ensemble.
Acceptance Test: UI label, serialized metadata, code lineage and tooltip all describe the same generator.

Finding: Residual detrending and endpoint baselines restart independently at each calendar year.
Impact: The 2027 segment can contain an artificial regime reset and nearly identical scenario timing.
Recommendation: Use one continuous horizon or an explicit state-transition boundary justified by data, not January 1.
Acceptance Test: Boundary discontinuity/derivative tests pass and 2027 dynamics retain scenario conditioning.

Finding: S2 contains 302 of 20,000 paths (1.51%, displayed as 2%); classification uses a fixed 2026-07-09 reference and trailing-drift GBM.
Impact: Small middle class and fixed thresholds can make S2 weight/endpoint sensitive to modest parameter changes.
Recommendation: Add bootstrap/parameter sensitivity that reclassifies paths, not terminal-scale-only sensitivity.
Acceptance Test: Weights and scenario membership are reported across predeclared mu/sigma/lookback/reference perturbations.

Finding: Structural disclosure text is appended non-idempotently; latest r8 repeats the lead sentence five times.
Impact: Revision notes accumulate noise and weaken audit readability.
Recommendation: Store disclosures in structured fields and make migration idempotent; correct only through a new immutable revision.
Acceptance Test: Repeated upgrade is a no-op and note/disclosure cardinality remains one.

Finding: Retrieved research text is inserted verbatim without an explicit untrusted-data boundary or instruction-in-source rejection rule.
Impact: Source-page prompt injection can influence synthesis.
Recommendation: Wrap evidence as quoted data objects and add non-execution rules plus injection tests.
Acceptance Test: Adversarial instructions inside evidence cannot alter system procedure or output schema.

Finding: OpenAI adapter counts URL annotations but stores only plain text; quality scoring separately parses textual URLs, so counts and preserved provenance can diverge.
Impact: Claims may lose machine-verifiable citation mapping and source counts can be inconsistent.
Recommendation: Persist provider annotations as source objects and link claim IDs to source IDs.
Acceptance Test: Every cited claim resolves to a stored URL/title/date/span; counts derive from the same objects.

Finding: Schema validates bounds but not anchor+signed deltas, CI containment, list cardinalities, decomposition math or snapshot completeness parity.
Impact: Structured output can be internally inconsistent while passing validation.
Recommendation: Add typed base rates, adjustments and decomposition nodes plus deterministic validators.
Acceptance Test: Invalid arithmetic/cardinality/CI/snapshot outputs are rejected before write.

Finding: Research quality grades unique URL domains, not claim support, publication/availability time, duplication, independence or contradiction.
Impact: A high source count can coexist with weak or irrelevant evidentiary support.
Recommendation: Introduce claim-level evidence records, source clusters, availability timestamps and entailment checks.
Acceptance Test: Quality gate fails unsupported material claims and duplicate/syndicated pseudo-independence.

Finding: The generic dualdb market/analog/deep-history digest can be injected into unrelated questions such as AAPL quarterly EPS.
Impact: Irrelevant context can anchor probabilities and consume reasoning budget.
Recommendation: Use domain-specific allowlists and relevance scoring; default to no quant context when no mapping exists.
Acceptance Test: Earnings prompts exclude market-cycle history unless a registered causal mapping passes a relevance gate.

Finding: KRunMedian repeats the same prompt and evidence without perturbation, role separation, independent retrieval or seeded diversity.
Impact: Multiple runs may measure sampling noise rather than independent judgment.
Recommendation: Use evidence-split or model/prompt-role challengers and track run correlation.
Acceptance Test: Ensemble adds skill or calibration in frozen backtests and has bounded pairwise correlation.

Finding: DECISIONS says dated snapshots only, while code accepts explicit tier slugs as snapshot identities.
Impact: The immutable provider contract is ambiguous and may not represent a reproducible model binary.
Recommendation: Choose one policy, record provider-returned model/version metadata, and add a contract test.
Acceptance Test: Docs, config, runtime guard and stored forecast identity agree exactly.

Finding: Ledger has six rows but only three unique resolved questions; four rows are revisions of one FOMC question.
Impact: Brier mean is descriptive, not evidence of generalized calibration or domain skill.
Recommendation: Evaluate first forecast per question and revision policy separately; accumulate preregistered OOS samples.
Acceptance Test: Promotion gates use unique questions, domain stratification, baseline comparison and confidence intervals.

Finding: 34 questions are active, 22 have no forecast record, and AMD Q2 is still active after its 2026-08-04 deadline.
Impact: Registry and execution cadence can drift, weakening the forward-test ledger.
Recommendation: Add due-state automation, expiry/hold rules and coverage SLA dashboards.
Acceptance Test: No active fixed-deadline item remains overdue; missing forecasts are explicitly held/blocked with reason.

Finding: Full SQLite and raw/source datasets are excluded, so exact k-NN neighbors and correction-episode sample cannot be independently reconstructed.
Impact: The package explains outputs but does not fully prove their underlying historical sample.
Recommendation: Include immutable raw manifests/URLs/hashes and a deterministic rebuild recipe or a sealed data pack.
Acceptance Test: Clean rebuild reproduces neighbor rows, derived features, episodes and context hash exactly.

Finding: The prompt says ambiguous questions should be rewritten and confirmed, but question_check is free text with no blocking field; the AAPL forecast recorded known EPS-definition/provider ambiguity.
Impact: A forecast can become official even when the model itself says the resolution contract is ambiguous.
Recommendation: Add a typed QuestionGateResult with proceed/hold and deterministic registry/snapshot checks before research and before write.
Acceptance Test: A materially ambiguous resolution or missing mandatory snapshot definition returns HOLD and produces no official revision.

Finding: research_status=degraded is recorded but does not block an official forecast; AAPL r1 was written as degraded.
Evidence: orchestrator.py::_research_status and write path; AAPL r1
Impact: Low-evidence outputs can enter the official forward-test ledger and contaminate calibration.
Recommendation: Introduce domain-specific minimum evidence gates and a held/degraded shadow-only state.
Acceptance Test: Official write requires required source/claim coverage; degraded runs remain scratch/shadow with costs logged.

Finding: Research agents are not prohibited from giving probabilities; the AAPL devil brief states YES 48% / NO 52%, which can anchor the final reasoner.
Impact: The final forecast is not cleanly separated from upstream model opinions.
Recommendation: Make research output claim-only and reject probability/target language outside the judgment stage.
Acceptance Test: Research schema contains no forecast probability field and a validator rejects probability recommendations.

Finding: Two benchmark rows store market probabilities as 22.0 and 5.0 instead of fractions, producing impossible Brier values 484 and 25; sync quarantines them.
Impact: Benchmark comparison coverage is reduced and direct CSV consumers may misread corrupted values.
Recommendation: Append corrected, unit-explicit records or a correction map; add semantic range checks at ingestion and ledger audit.
Acceptance Test: All probability columns carry a declared unit and satisfy [0,1]; corrected rows supersede bad rows without silent history edits.
